subject: Binding pathways and legal handoff cadence: MAP checkpoint and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@helixcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Binding pathways and legal handoff cadence: MAP checkpoint and evidence cadence

Elaine —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short mutual action plan draft and a proposed evidence cadence so procurement and legal have clear handoffs. Attached: HLC_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owner/date columns).

High-level asks from our side:
- Can HelixCare confirm target sign date window for the MSA + DPA + Order Form (we had discussed late June to early July)?
- Please confirm who will own the procurement milestone (name + email) so we can include them in the MAP and route evidence requests.
- Any blackout dates for your security team for evidence review in the next two weeks?

Suggested legal sequencing (for planning):
1) Redwood to deliver finalized DPA redline for HelixCare legal (target: 3 business days after we get procurement contact)
2) Parallel prep: purchase order / order form template populated for pricing and billing contacts
3) Finalize MSA signature gate once DPA language agreed (can be same signature event)

Quick coordination call? I propose a 30-min checkpoint the week of 6/7 to lock dates. Available: Mon 6/7 10–12 PT or Tue 6/8 1–4 PT.

Attachments: HLC_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to the procurement contact so we can start the DPA handoff.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Binding pathways and legal handoff cadence: MAP checkpoint and evidence cadence

Vanessa —

Appreciate the MAP draft. Quick answers:
- Target sign window: our procurement lead is aiming for signatures between 6/24 and 6/30 (internal finance approval pending but likely by mid-June).
- Procurement owner: Ravi Shah (ravi.shah@helixcare.com) — I've cc'd his contact below in my note to him. He will lead PO and order form intake.
- Security evidence review: security is available the week of 6/8 but prefers all evidence submitted by 6/4 for a preliminary pass. After that they'll do a final verification 6/15–6/18.

Two immediate asks from my side:
1) Can Redwood align on which SOC 2 scope we will provide and a targeted delivery date for the report? (Our security needs to confirm mappings.)
2) Do you anticipate any KMS/HSM integration notes to be included in the DPA (we need to flag this to our infra team)?

Looping in Ravi in a follow-up so he can be in the MAP directly.

Thanks —
Elaine Park
Head of Vendor Ops, HelixCare
elaine.park@helixcare.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Binding pathways and legal handoff cadence: MAP checkpoint and evidence cadence

Elaine / Vanessa —

Thanks for the notes, Elaine — solid. A few legal sequencing details from our side to insert into the MAP (I added inline comments in the DPA redline I am attaching). Attachment: DPA_redline_v2.docx

Proposed sequencing (concrete dates for planning):
- 6/01: Redwood to send initial DPA redline (done — see attachment)
- 6/04: HelixCare security preliminary evidence pass (per Elaine) — please confirm reviewer email(s)
- 6/10–6/12: Redwood responds to any HelixCare DPA markups / SOC2 scoping questions
- 6/15: Final DPA signoff target (legal agree-to-sign ready)
- 6/24–6/30: Signature window for MSA + DPA + Order Form (Elaine's procurement target)

Dependencies / blockers we need HelixCare to confirm ASAP:
- SOC 2 scope and whether a shared mapping document is required for controls (if yes, we can provide our SOC 2 report by 6/4 but need confirmation on the mapping template)
- KMS/HSM requirement: if HelixCare requires customer-managed keys that may change time to production — flag now so we can scope ops work
- Any specific indemnity or data residency clauses that HelixCare legal will expect to redline beyond standard DPA (call out early).

If those dependencies are locked, the sequence above keeps us on a clean path to the late-June signature window. I also added a short fallback: if SOC2 mapping takes longer, we can proceed with an interim DPA addendum plus a 90-day closure for outstanding evidence.

I can join a 30-min call the morning of Mon 6/7 (10–11 PT) to finalize owners and put the MAP into a shared Google Sheet.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Elaine / Ravi —

Great — thanks for the speed. Recap and next steps so we have an agreed single source of truth: 

Mutual Action Plan excerpt (owners + dates):
- Redwood: Deliver final SOC2 report & mapping template — owner: Vanessa Ortiz — target: 2026-06-04 (deliverable: SOC2_report_redwood.pdf + mapping doc)
- HelixCare: Preliminary security evidence pass — owner: HelixCare Security Team (please confirm reviewer email) — target: 2026-06-04
- Legal (both): Complete DPA review and sign-off — owner: Karthik Iyer / HelixCare counsel — target: 2026-06-15
- Procurement: Finalize PO and Order Form, submit to Redwood for signature — owner: Ravi Shah — target: 2026-06-20
- Joint: Formal signature window for MSA + DPA + Order Form — target: 2026-06-24 to 2026-06-30

Open items for HelixCare to confirm:
1) Confirm security reviewer email(s) for the 6/4 pass so we can upload evidence to the secure portal.
2) Confirm whether HelixCare requires customer-managed KMS; if yes, we will engage infra and adjust timelines.
3) Any required PO billing contact details so we can pre-fill the Order Form template (Ravi, can you supply?)

I've uploaded the MAP (v1) to our shared folder and attached the DPA redline from Karthik. If everyone is aligned, I'll book the 30-min cadence call for Mon 6/7 10:00–10:30 PT to lock owners and convert the MAP into a shared Google Sheet.

Attachments: DPA_redline_v2.docx, HLC_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

—
